basic_info.description: Beautifully reimagined Marina-style corner home in San Francisco's Outer Mission. This 4-bedroom plus office flex space, 3-bath residence offers a flexible floor plan filled with natural light from its rare corner-lot windows. The main level features a spacious living and dining area, chef's kitchen with Thermador range and peninsula island, plus a primary suite retreat with soaking tub and dual vanities. A lower level provides additional rooms, family room, full bath, and spacious garage with storage. Enjoy a flat, low-maintenance backyard and easy access to Balboa Park, McLaren Park, Mission Street shops, Geneva Avenue, BART, MUNI, and quick freeway connections.
